title: Walls above roof level.
officialText:
Masonry walls above roof level, 12 feet (3658 mm) or less in height, enclosing stairways,
machinery rooms, shafts, or penthouses, may be up to 8 inches (203 mm) thick and shall be considered as neither increasing
the height, nor requiring any increase in the thickness of the wall below.
